itens.titulo: Nvidia-Backed Data Center Firm Nscale Files Publicly for US IPO
itens.descricao: Nvidia-Backed Data Center Firm Nscale Files Publicly for US IPO Yahoo! Finance Canada
trechos: Spun off from a cryptocurrency mining operation in early 2024, Nscale quickly became one of the most prominent data center newcomers powering the AI boom as a so-called neocloud operator, renting out computing resources to companies developing AI.
It was valued in March at about $14.6 billion, in a Series C funding round led by Aker ASA and investment firm 8090 Industries.
Nscale is seeking to raise as much as $3 billion in the IPO, Bloomberg News reported.
It had also been in talks with potential investors to raise as much as $3.5 billion in financing ahead of the listing.
It agreed in April to add more than 30,000 Nvidia chips to an existing rental agreement with Microsoft at its so-called gigafactory in Narvik, Norway.
Anthropic PBC said in August it has agreed to spend $45 billion to rent AI cloud computing power from the company's flagship data center development in West Virginia.
Companies offering investors exposure to AI infrastructure have lifted this year's first-time share sale volume to $161.4 billion, the most since 2021, data compiled by Bloomberg show.

SpaceX raised $86.2 billion in its record IPO touting revenue from selling AI processing power to companies including Anthropic, while South Korean memory chipmaker SK Hynix Inc.'s $26.5 billion listing came with a data center-focused pitch.
